issues.title: Avatar hidden behind content box in intro/memory modes
issues.description: In intro and memory section modes, the avatar appears behind the content box instead of in front. The content box needs lower z-index or avatar needs higher z-index for these modes.
issues.solution: Repositioned mode-center layout: avatar now on right side (right: 5%, height: 85%, z-index: 15), content-wrapper on left side (z-index: 10, padding-left: 5%, max-width: 65%). This gives the avatar clear visibility alongside content rather than hidden behind it.

issues.title: Text content not displaying when sharing/loading videos
issues.description: When accessing the player via shared URL, text content doesn't appear in content-box. May be race condition with displayItems population or typewriter initialization.
issues.solution: Root cause: segment-item and flashcard had very low default opacity (0.3-0.4) making them nearly invisible on dark background. Fixed by: 1) Increased base opacity to 0.7-0.75, 2) Added logic to mark first segment/flashcard as active on load for full visibility.

issues.title: Player initial load is very slow
issues.description: Player takes too long to load initially. Likely caused by preloading all audio files upfront instead of on-demand.
issues.solution: Implemented lazy video detection: 1) Only detect videos for current slide before showing UI, 2) Added detectVideosForSlide() with caching, 3) Background detection for remaining slides via detectRemainingVideosInBackground(), 4) Made loadSlide async to support on-demand detection.

issues.title: Avatar too small in video-primary mode and blank video at start
issues.description: When video plays, avatar is super tiny. Also blank video box appears before content loads. Avatar should be larger and content should appear instantly.
issues.solution: 1) Increased mode-content-video avatar size to 55% height and 35% max-width, 2) Added video-box opacity:0 by default with .video-ready class for opacity:1, 3) Added oncanplay event to add video-ready class when video is ready to play.

issues.title: LaTeX symbols in narration text cause TTS to read raw LaTeX
issues.description: Mathematical symbols like $h$ are passed to TTS as-is, so narration says 'dollar h dollar' instead of 'h'. Need to strip/convert LaTeX before sending to TTS.
issues.solution: Created core/latex_to_speech.py that converts LaTeX to speakable text (fractions, powers, Greek letters, operators). Integrated into tts/generate_audio.py to process narration before Narakeet API call.

issues.title: Add dev mode position/size stats overlay for layout debugging
issues.description: When toggling dev mode, display real-time position and size statistics for content wrapper and avatar so user can provide feedback on layout adjustments.
issues.solution: Added #dev-stats-overlay in player HTML showing layout mode, avatar position/size/aspect, content position/size, video box dimensions. Stats update every 500ms when visible. Toggle with D key or Dev button.

issues.title: Manim video sometimes cuts off at bottom
issues.description: Manim-rendered videos sometimes have content that extends below the visible area. Need dynamic vertical centering or adjustment based on video content.
issues.prior_attempt: Added object-fit: contain but video-box container height was still constrained by max-height: 60vh.
issues.solution: Changed video-box to height: fit-content and overflow: visible, video element to height: auto with max-height: 80vh. This allows videos to display at natural aspect ratio while preventing viewport overflow.

issues.title: Manim video cutoff - video-box height constraint too small
issues.description: Video-box had max-height: 60vh which was too small for taller Manim animations. Content at bottom of video was clipped.
issues.solution: Changed #stage from fixed height: 720px to min-height: 720px, height: auto, max-height: 90vh. This allows stage to expand for taller videos. Combined with max-height: 90vh on .mode-content-video #video-box for contained presentation.

issues.title: Text not displayed in content-video mode
issues.description: In mode-content-video, the content-box was hidden by default (max-width: 0, opacity: 0). Text only appeared when .text-visible class was manually added.
issues.solution: Modified player.js loadSlide() to synchronously detect rendered content (segments-list children, flashcards, quiz-containers) after DOM population. Adds .text-visible class when content exists, removes when empty. No setTimeout - runs immediately after content insertion.

issues.title: Avatar loses resolution/aspect ratio when resized
issues.description: When avatar is resized or repositioned, it appears stretched or loses quality. Aspect ratio should be maintained.
issues.solution: Added image-rendering: -webkit-optimize-contrast and image-rendering: crisp-edges to #avatar-canvas for better quality during canvas rendering.

issues.title: v1.2 Architecture Upgrade - 3-Pass LLM Pipeline
issues.description: Upgrade from 2-LLM architecture to 3-pass architecture with role-pure separation of concerns. Pass 0: Chunker (Gemini Flash), Pass 1: Director (Gemini Pro) for pedagogy only, Pass 2: Specialized renderers (Claude Sonnet for Manim/Remotion, Gemini Pro for Video).
issues.solution: Created: 1) core/llm_client_v12.py with 3-pass pipeline functions, 2) core/analytics.py for per-phase cost/time tracking, 3) core/pipeline_v12.py for production use, 4) 10 new prompt files in core/prompts/, 5) Backed up v1.1 to pipeline_v11.py and prompts/v1.1_backup/. Added validation to strip renderer fields from Director output and verify renderer output exists after Pass 2.

Director generating 109-120 word narrations instead of 150+

issues.title: Manim renderer expects v1.1 visual_beats but v1.2 provides section-level manim_scene_spec
issues.description: v1.2 Director generates manim_scene_spec at section level (not per visual_beat). The Manim runner tries to iterate through visual_beats calling compile_manim_plan() on each, which fails because v1.2 visual_beats only have {time, description} fields, not the structured manim_scene_spec required by Visual Compiler.
issues.root_cause: Architecture mismatch: v1.2 uses 3-pass architecture where Manim Renderer LLM generates the full manim_scene_spec for the whole section, but manim_runner.py's multi-beat path calls compile_manim_plan() on each beat expecting v1.1 structure.
fix: 1. renderer_executor.py: Store v1.2 manim_scene_spec under 'v12_manim_scene_spec' key
2. manim_runner.py: Added _render_v12_manim_spec() function to detect v12 spec BEFORE multi-beat iteration
3. Uses translate_spec_to_manim_code() directly to render single video for entire section
files_changed: core/renderer_executor.py: Changed key from compiled_manim_plan to v12_manim_scene_spec
render/manim/manim_runner.py: Added _render_v12_manim_spec() function, updated render_manim_video() to check for v12 spec first

issues.title: Manim CLI crashes on labels with latex property
issues.description: Manim render fails for content_01 and content_02 sections while example_01 succeeds. Root cause: LLM generates labels with 'latex' property (e.g., '\text{coefficient of }x^2') but translate_spec_to_manim_code() label handler only checks for 'text' property, falling back to object ID and using Text() instead of MathTex().
symptoms: Manim CLI crashes with truncated stacktrace
Return code: 1 from manim render command
example_01 succeeds but content_01 and content_02 fail
issues.root_cause: Label handler in visual_compiler.py only checked props.get('text'), not props.get('latex'). When LLM uses latex for mathematical labels, the code generated invalid Text() calls instead of MathTex().
issues.fix: Updated label handler in translate_spec_to_manim_code() to: 1) Check for latex property first, 2) Use MathTex() with scale when latex is provided, 3) Fall back to Text() only for plain text labels.

issues.title: Manim crashes due to \text{} in MathTex being converted to Tex
issues.description: _sanitize_manim_code() was converting MathTex to Tex when \text{} was present, but this caused 'Missing $ inserted' LaTeX errors because Tex uses non-math mode where \text{} and superscripts don't work together.
issues.error: LaTeX compilation error: Missing $ inserted. Context: \begin{center} a: \text{coefficient of }x^2 \end{center}
issues.fix: Changed _sanitize_manim_code() to replace \text{} with \textrm{} instead of converting MathTex to Tex. \textrm{} works properly in math mode.

issues.title: Graph objects fail when axes not defined in spec
issues.description: LLM generates graph objects that reference 'axes' variable but doesn't include an axes object in the spec. This causes NameError: name 'axes' is not defined.
issues.fix: Added auto-axes creation in translate_spec_to_manim_code(): Pre-scans objects for graph/area_under_graph types, checks if referenced axes are declared, and auto-creates missing axes with default x_range=[-5,5,1], y_range=[-3,3,1]. Logs warning when fallback axes are generated.

issues.title: Legacy endpoints use shared ASSETS_DIR instead of job folders
issues.description: /process_pdf and /process_markdown endpoints bypass job isolation by writing directly to player/assets/ instead of creating job-specific folders. This causes assets to overwrite each other between jobs.
issues.fix: Updated both endpoints to create job folders using job_manager.create_job() and setup_job_folder(), matching the /submit endpoint pattern.

issues.title: Player.js AVATAR_URL hardcoded to shared assets path
issues.description: AVATAR_URL constant in player.js is hardcoded to /player/assets/avatar_placeholder.mp4 instead of using job-relative path.
issues.fix: Changed AVATAR_URL to use BASE_PATH + 'avatar_placeholder.mp4' for job-relative resolution.

issues.title: File-based job storage not scalable for production
issues.description: Current architecture uses single in-process JobManager with file-based storage. Cannot handle 50,000+ concurrent jobs due to: serialized execution, no cleanup mechanism, inode exhaustion risk, slow I/O under load.
issues.recommended_solution: Externalize job metadata to PostgreSQL, use Redis/SQS job queue with worker processes, move media to S3 + CDN, make API stateless.

issues.title: All video sections overwrite same file (topic_1.mp4)
issues.description: renderer_executor.py uses topic.get('id', 1) but director outputs section_id (e.g. content_01). All sections fall back to id=1, causing all videos to overwrite topic_1.mp4. Player shows black screen.
symptoms: Only 1 video file in videos folder
All Manim sections logged as topic_1

issues.title: presentation.json missing content_video_path for sections

issues.title: render_prompts.json mislabels Manim specs as wan_prompt

issues.title: Manim animation starts with 8-second blank screen
issues.description: LLM generates 'wait' action of 8 seconds at the start of animation_sequence. This causes blank screen before content appears. Equations should appear earlier to match narration start.
issues.fix_required: Update Manim renderer prompt to prohibit long initial wait actions and start animation immediately with first visual element.
issues.solution: Updated manim_renderer_system_v1.2.txt and manim_renderer_user_v1.2.txt with TIMING RULES section requiring first action be visual element. Re-rendered job 4f3411e9 - all 3 sections now start with show_equation (duration 1-2s).

issues.title: Manim animation has idle period at end with no visual activity
issues.description: Animation ends with static visuals while narration continues. The 4-6 seconds at the end have no visual motion to accompany the closing recap narration.
issues.fix_required: Update Manim renderer prompt to include closing animation (e.g., fade out, summary highlight, or recap motion) during final seconds.
issues.solution: Added CLOSING ANIMATION REQUIRED rule to prompts. Re-rendered sections now end with highlight actions on key elements (main_equation, quadratic_formula, final_box).

issues.title: Manim layout overcrowding - equations and labels overlap
issues.description: In topic_example_01.mp4 (screenshot 3), multiple equations and steps are rendered too close together, making the screen cluttered and hard to read. Text overlaps and spacing is insufficient.
issues.good_example: topic_content_01.mp4 (screenshot 2) shows clean layout with clear spacing between equation, labels, and arrows
issues.fix_required: Update Manim renderer prompt with layout/spacing guidelines: minimum 1.0 unit vertical spacing between elements, use VGroup for organizing related elements, avoid placing more than 3-4 equation lines on screen simultaneously.
issues.solution: Added LAYOUT RULES section with vertical spacing requirements (1.5 units), screen regions, and max 4 elements visible. example_01 now uses y-positions: 2.5, 1.5, 0, -1.5, -2.5 with proper 1.0-1.5 unit gaps.

issues.title: Manim content_02 Discriminant label overlaps formula
issues.description: In topic_content_02.mp4 (screenshot 1), the 'Discriminant' label is positioned inside the square root sign area, overlapping with the formula. Label should be positioned above or beside the formula with an arrow.
issues.fix_required: Update Manim renderer prompt to specify label positioning rules: labels should not overlap with formulas, use arrows to point from labels to formula parts.
issues.solution: Added LABEL POSITIONING rules requiring 0.8+ unit separation. Re-rendered content_02 has discriminant_label at y=1 (above formula elements at y=0.5 and below).

issues.title: Avatar missing (null) in presentation.json
issues.description: Job b5042fd3 has avatar: null in presentation.json. Director LLM did not set avatar metadata, causing avatar not to display.
issues.root_cause: Director prompts (v1.2) did not explicitly require avatar field. LLM inferred it sometimes but not consistently.
issues.fix_required: Update Director prompts to mandate avatar field. Add hard-fail validation for null avatar.
issues.solution: Created v1.3 Director prompts with explicit AVATAR RULES section per section type. Added avatar validation in hard_fail_validator.py.

issues.title: Summary section missing from presentation
issues.description: Job b5042fd3 has no summary section. Director LLM did not generate a summary section at all.
issues.root_cause: Director prompts (v1.2) mentioned summary but did not enforce as mandatory with hard-fail validation.
issues.fix_required: Update Director prompts to mandate summary section. Add hard-fail validation for missing sections.
issues.solution: Created v1.3 Director prompts with MANDATORY SECTION ORDER and hard failure rule. Added validate_v13_structure() to check for intro, summary, memory, recap.

issues.title: Intro text not displayed properly
issues.description: Intro section visual_beats contain descriptive text instead of display text. Player cannot render proper intro overlays.
issues.root_cause: v1.2 prompts allowed LLM to output scene descriptions instead of structured display_directives.
issues.fix_required: Update Director prompts to require display_directives for every narration segment with text_layer, visual_layer, avatar_layer.
issues.solution: Created v1.3 with DISPLAY DIRECTION section requiring display_directives on every segment. Added validate_v13_section_rules() to check for missing directives.

issues.title: Recap and Memory sections fail hard-fail validation despite retry mechanism
issues.description: Dry runs with both Gemini 2.5 Pro and Claude 3.5 Sonnet produce recap sections with 0 scenes (need 5) and memory sections with 0 flashcards (need 5). Schema validation passes but semantic validation fails. Director retry logic exists but isn't catching these structural issues at schema level.
validation_failures: recap_scene_count_wrong: Recap section has 0 scenes, must be exactly 5
recap_narration_below_minimum: Recap total narration is 0 words, minimum is 300
memory_flashcard_count_wrong: Memory section has 0 flashcards, must be exactly 5
issues.root_cause: Schema only validates general structure (visual_beats array), not section-type-specific content like recap scenes or memory flashcards. Additionally, hard_fail_validator was looking for legacy fields (recap_scenes, flashcards) instead of v1.3 structure (visual_beats).

details: Update JSON schema to require exactly 5 recap scenes in visual_beats when section_type=recap
Update JSON schema to require exactly 5 flashcards in visual_beats when section_type=memory
Keep semantic retry logic for word-count and visualization rules
Add canonical JSON examples for memory and recap sections in Director system prompt
approved_solution.rationale: Schema-level enforcement triggers retry mechanism before reaching semantic validator. Prompt examples reduce retry frequency by showing LLM exact expected format.

solution: 1. Updated schemas/presentation_v1.3.schema.json with section-type-specific definitions (memory_section, recap_section, generic_section) using oneOf pattern. Memory and recap sections now require exactly 5 visual_beats.
2. Added canonical JSON examples for memory (5 flashcards) and recap (5 scenes with 60-100 word narration each) sections to core/prompts/director_system_v1.3.txt
3. Fixed core/hard_fail_validator.py to read from visual_beats instead of legacy recap_scenes/flashcards fields for v1.3 validation
4. Fixed recap narration word count to read from narration.segments instead of legacy scene-based structure

issues.title: display_directives at section-level array instead of per-segment - Player cannot read them

Result: Player never sees display_directives, text/visual toggling fails.
issues.spec_reference: docs/llm_output_requirements_v1.3.json requires display_directives on each narration.segments entry
upstream_impact: core/prompts/director_system_v1.3.txt - Canonical JSON example shows wrong structure
core/prompts/director_retry_system_v1.3.txt - Retry prompt may perpetuate wrong structure
downstream_impact: player/player.js LayerController - Cannot find display_directives, defaults to hide all
Text/visual mutual exclusion enforcement not triggered
solution: 1. Updated director_system_v1.3.txt canonical JSON to embed display_directives inside each narration segment with flat string enums
2. Updated schemas/presentation_v1.3.schema.json to require display_directives on narration_segment with enum validation
3. Updated tier1_structural.py to validate per-segment display_directives with flat string format and mutual exclusion check
4. Updated director_retry_system_v1.3.txt with explicit fix instructions for display_directives structure

issues.title: Player reads slide.narration_segments but v1.3 uses slide.narration.segments

issues.title: Player reads slide.recap_scenes but v1.3 uses slide.visual_beats for recap
issues.description: Recap section navigation checks slide.recap_scenes, but v1.3 stores scene data in slide.visual_beats[]. Result: Recap scene navigation broken.

issues.title: Player reads slide.visual_content.bullet_points - keep for future use

issues.title: v1.3 schema missing visual_content channel - narration text displayed instead of document content
issues.description: The v1.3 schema lacked a dedicated visual_content field at the narration segment level. Narration text (audio script) was being displayed on screen instead of structured display content (bullet points, formulas, labels) extracted from the source document.
issues.root_cause: Schema separation issue - narration.segments[].text is meant for TTS audio only, but player had nowhere else to get displayable content from. The visual_content channel was never added to the schema.
symptoms: Player displays narration transcript on screen
Bullet points from source document not visible
Text layer shows voiceover script instead of structured content
Progressive reveal of bullets not possible

solution.schema_changes: Added visual_content object to narration_segment in presentation_v1.3.schema.json with bullet_points[] (level, text), formula, labels[]
solution.docs_changes: Updated llm_output_requirements_v1.3.json with two-channel separation documentation
prompt_changes: Added TWO-CHANNEL SEPARATION and VISUAL_CONTENT RULES sections to director_system_v1.3.txt
Updated canonical JSON examples in director_system_v1.3.txt with visual_content field
Updated director_retry_system_v1.3.txt with visual_content repair instructions
player_changes: Added aggregation of visual_content from all segments in slide mapping
Added bullet-level-1 and bullet-level-2 CSS classes for hierarchy styling
Updated segment rendering to detect {level, text} objects and apply appropriate classes
Added whitelist-based legacy version guard: ['', 'v1.0', 'v1.1', 'v1.2'] get narration fallback, v1.3+ enforces visual_content
Added visible error placeholder for v1.3+ violations: '[Missing display content - visual_content required]'
validator_changes: Added tier1 validation: text_layer=show segments require visual_content for content/example/intro/summary sections

backward_compatibility.v13_behavior: Enforces visual_content, shows error placeholder if missing
